main_text.l: quartum item, sed extra fossam, nec
vallo contiguum, portæ Orientali objec-
tum: adhæc alia duo ejusdem generis,
vallo conjuncta sed minora: & præter
ea ex lateribus structa VII, quædam tur-
riculis fastigiata, quædam sine fastigijs:
omnia muniendæ urbi contra vim hosti-
lem instituta. Quinetiam durante hoc
bello Belgico, suburbium, quod ante
dixi, & ingens, & ædificiis non infre-
quens, à navicularijs habitatum, à quo-
rum navigiis & amne nomen quoq; traxit
[Schutendiep enim vulgò nuncupatur)
duabus portis prætextum, Polanæ ac
Steentillanæ, vallo terreo haud infirmo,
& fossa benè profunda est incinctum, ut
penè non minùs urbe ipsa tutum sitab ho-
stili incursu & vi, ac quasi urbi adjectum.
Cætera suburbia egregia, præsertim an-
te portas Dominicam, Botteranam,
Amnicam belli injuris jam perière:quam-
quam ante Amnicam, vallum cum fos-
sa, castelli in modum, ductum partem
suburbii etiam nunc includat; portam-
que eandem protegat. Id verò subur-
bium, quod ante portam Dominicam fuit

page.notes: The marginal note is set in italic, with its lines broken by hyphens; "extraprium" is doubtful. Black letter in the bracketed word "Schutendiep" is transcribed as printed. "sitab" and "perière:quam-" are printed without spaces and are copied as they stand. The catchword "fuit" is set at the lower right and is not repeated in the text. Running head and page number are taken from the top of the page.
